_comment: Per-model contract of the paper harness (PAPER_PLAN section 4 and 9; DESIGN.md section 2). embed.py reads this file. 'revision' = Hugging Face commit resolved on 2026-10-15; embed.py --revision latest ignores it and records what it resolved. All three models are 768-d (stated limit). The first 512 dimensions of a vector feed our binary code and int8 screen (code_width / int8_width are the K4 defaults; dev decides, frozen at S7); this is an empirical choice, not a property of the model.

contract.our_f16_rounding: nearest-even (round to nearest, ties to even, float32 -> float16 for our vector file)
contract.truncation: tokenizer truncation to 512 tokens, right side, for documents and queries; counts of cut texts are written to model.json
contract.ground_truth_cosine: stored float32 vectors normalised in float64 (gt.py); the stored vectors are L2-normalised to float32 precision

CodeRankEmbed.query_prefix: Represent this query for searching relevant code:
CodeRankEmbed.card: model card: sentence-transformers Transformer + CLS Pooling (1_Pooling/config.json: pooling_mode_cls_token true); queries need the prefix, documents none. THE PRODUCT DOES NOT FOLLOW THE CARD: it mean-pools (crates/sweet-search-native/src/inference/embedding_model.rs: NomicBERT encoder -> mean_pool(hidden, mask) -> L2_normalize). All existing CodeRankEmbed vectors of the paper (code sets) are mean-pooled.
CodeRankEmbed.notes: Pooling is 'mean' (the product's) so that embed.py output is the same model as the existing code-set vectors: measured on 16 GCSN documents with exact texts, fp32 HF weights + mean pooling vs the stored vectors: min cosine 0.99969, median 0.99975; with the card's CLS pooling: min 0.704, median 0.832. The existing vectors were made by the product's native Metal / CoreML path (bf16 weights) and the product text recipe; the queries by the product's query path (prefix as in query_prefix).

jina-v2-base-code.card: 1_Pooling/config.json: pooling_mode_mean_tokens true; no prefixes; ALiBi, native length 8192 (we cut at 512 for all models)
jina-v2-base-code.notes: Remote code (JinaBertModel) is loaded from the repository named in remote_code_repos.

bge-base-en-v1.5.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
bge-base-en-v1.5.card: 1_Pooling/config.json: pooling_mode_cls_token true, then Normalize; the retrieval instruction is added to queries only (BEIR / C-MTEB retrieval)
bge-base-en-v1.5.notes: Used for the text (BEIR) sets. Its tokenizer lower-cases (do_lower_case true).
